ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Letting, Viewing and later stages need Next step date.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Letting", CASE(StageName, "Enquiry", 1, "Requirement qualified", 2, "Viewing", 3, "Offer", 4, "Heads of terms", 5, "Referencing", 6, "Legals", 7, "Completed", 8, 0) >= 3, ISBLANK(Next_step_date__c))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Next step date before moving to Viewing.
